questions.passage: On June 30, 1908, a 160-foot-wide space rock hurtling toward Earth exploded in a remote forested area of Siberia. Known as the Tunguska event, after a river that ran through the region, ____ June 30 has been officially denoted International Asteroid Day.

explanation.detailed: 先判断 Known as the Tunguska event 的逻辑对象：第一句介绍了1908年的爆炸，接着给该事件命名。因此主句应立即以 the explosion 为主语。C 随后用 and 并列 obliterated 和 inspired 两个谓语，完整说明爆炸的破坏与纪念意义；最后以冒号引出 International Asteroid Day 的具体日期。这里的关键不是选项中是否出现 explosion，而是它是否成为句首修饰语所依附的主语。

choice_analysis.A: 主语是 the forest，误使森林成为被称作 Tunguska event 的对象；后面再出现 by the explosion 不能修复这一悬垂修饰。
